how_weights_work: Final score = sum(weight x predicted probability of the viewer taking that action). Weights scale per-viewer predicted probabilities, not raw counts. The linter can say which actions a post invites; it cannot compute rank.

rules.check: Contains something worth sending to a colleague: a number, steps, a test, a template, or a repo.
rules.fix: Add the one concrete artifact: the number, the test, or the link to what you built.

rules.check: Ends on a real question or an answerable claim. Replies from mutual follows get a +15 boost.
rules.fix: End with the question you actually want answered by people who do this work.

rules.check: Has one standalone, quotable claim under 120 characters.
rules.fix: Lead with the claim in one sentence people could quote with their own take.

rules.check: Shows first-hand practice (I built, I ran, I tested) or belongs to a series.
rules.fix: Say what you did, not what people should do.

rules.check: Enough substance to read: 120+ characters or an image.
rules.fix: Add one more concrete sentence, or a screenshot.

rules.check: Info: likes (0.5) and reposts (1.0) are weak signals. Don't optimize for them.
No engagement bait, giveaways, or hostility.
At most 2 hashtags, 3 mentions, 4 emoji, 3 all-caps words.
On-topic for your target personas, no hype phrasing.
rules.fix: Tie it to agents, AI dev, or DevRel, and drop the hype words.

rules.check: A link isn't the whole post. Link opens are worth 0.2; the post has to earn replies and shares on its own.
rules.fix: Put the finding in the post; the link is the receipt.

rules.check: Your next post in a viewer's feed is multiplied by 0.5, then down to 0.25. Space posts out.
rules.fix: Wait, or merge into your earlier post.

rules.check: Not a near-duplicate of a recent post. The reranker spaces out similar posts.
rules.fix: Find a new angle or skip it.

rules.check: Originals travel further. Replies and reposts are discounted like out-of-network posts.
rules.fix: If it stands alone, post it as an original.

rules.check: Video is at least 10 seconds to count as a quality view.
Info: accounts under 1,000 followers get a new-author boost on posts under 24h old with under 1,000 impressions.
Info: posts older than 48 hours drop out of For You.

not_in_code: No hard link penalty appears in these weights. Claims of a 30-50% link penalty come from third-party blogs, not this file.
No bookmark weight and no Premium boost appear in this param file.
Grox spam/quality classifier prompts and some labeling rules are not published.

daily.task: Write 5 substantive replies to posts from your target personas, ideally under 2 hours old.
daily.why: Replies weigh 5, and replies between mutual follows get +15 more. Good replies are how strangers become mutuals.
daily.done_when: 5 replies of 15+ words each, to accounts on your persona lists

daily.task: Answer everyone who replied to your posts in the last 24 hours.
daily.why: Turns repliers into mutuals, which unlocks the +15 mutual reply boost next time.

daily.task: Post one original that passes the gate (8+).
daily.why: Originals avoid the 0.75 discount applied to replies and reposts. One strong post beats three, since each extra post in a viewer's feed is halved.
daily.done_when: 1 original posted, max 3 per day, 3h apart

daily.task: Follow 3 builders from your persona lists who engaged with you or whose work you replied to.
daily.why: Mutual follows are what the +15 reply boost keys on. Follow-graph edges also feed the account credibility score.

weekly.task: Post one thing people would send to a colleague: a number, a test, a repo, or steps.
weekly.why: Copy-link shares are the largest positive weight (20).

weekly.task: Post one native screenshot or a 10s+ clip of something you built.
weekly.why: Native media adds dwell; video under 10s doesn't count as a quality view.

weekly.task: Check which personas your week's posts actually reached and adjust next week's targets.
weekly.why: 'Not interested' (-43.2) comes from reaching the wrong people.

monthly.task: Post at least 10 times this month.
monthly.why: Under the Hood stats require 10+ posts in the previous month.

monthly.task: Check Under the Hood for labels on your account or posts.
monthly.why: Labels drive visibility filtering, which can drop posts after ranking.

anti_homework: No 'great post!' replies. Low-effort replies invite mutes (-58.8) and don't create mutuals.
No reply-guy volume. The replies cap is the target, not a floor to exceed.
Stop when the daily list is done. Scrolling past the time budget isn't homework.

algorithm_fit.what: Live 0-10 score of how well a draft invites what X's ranker rewards and avoids what it penalizes. Computed in the browser on every keystroke, no model call.
algorithm_fit.hit_formula: 10 * sum(w_i * s_i) / sum(w_i), s = 1 pass, 0.5 warn, 0 fail. Weights are the summed param.rs weights per rule, square-root scaled so copy-link shares (20) can't drown out everything else.
algorithm_fit.report_cap: Any bait/hostility fail caps fit at 1.0
algorithm_fit.caveat: Fit says which actions a draft invites. It does not predict rank, since weights scale each viewer's own predicted probabilities.
